name: Jayapura

queries.query: Jayapura Indonesia official cadastral parcel map ATR BPN public API
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official ATR/BPN ATLAS portal and the municipal Smart Asset Kota Jayapura map. The municipal land layer is a public inventory of 115 land assets with point geometries, not a parcel-polygon service. No safe anonymous Jayapura cadastral polygon response was identified.

queries.query: Jayapura peta bidang tanah resmi ATR BPN layanan peta kadaster Kota Jayapura
queries.result: Pencarian berbahasa Indonesia menemukan portal resmi ATLAS ATR/BPN dan peta aset tanah Pemerintah Kota Jayapura. Endpoint aset tanah publik mengembalikan 115 fitur Point dengan atribut inventaris; tidak mengembalikan poligon bidang tanah. Tidak ditemukan respons anonim yang aman untuk bidang tanah kadaster Kota Jayapura.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Pemerintah Kota Jayapura's Smart Asset map is an evidenced local municipal land-asset inventory; its public land endpoint returned 115 point features. This is a local map/registry evidence, but not cadastral parcel geometry.
regionalOrNationalSources: ATR/BPN ATLAS is the official national geospatial portal and was loaded as a public catalog surface.
The municipal Smart Asset map is the only Jayapura-specific public map response obtained in this attempt.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: Local municipal land-asset map and its public GeoJSON endpoint were verified. Cadastral parcel coverage, parcel identity semantics, and citywide completeness were not verified; registryFound is true for the evidenced local map, not for cadastral admission.

requestOutcomes: TLS-verified anonymous GET of https://atlas.atrbpn.go.id/ returned HTTP 200; current Next.js entrypoints were fetched and inspected, but no safe Jayapura parcel feature request was exposed. TLS-verified anonymous GET of https://smartaset.jayapurakota.go.id/?type=1 returned HTTP 200 and exposed the current JavaScript/configuration routes. TLS-verified anonymous GET of https://smartaset.jayapurakota.go.id/api/lands/geojson returned HTTP 200 with a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of 115 Point features. The nearest returned asset point was approximately 437 m from the exact WUP point; this was not used as a parcel hit. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS verification disable was used.
